can you look this warning :

`packet-isobus.c:763 proto_tree_add_item called for FT_UINT24 field "hf_isobus_ack_pgn"  - with bad encoding - "ENC_NA" - {'ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN', 'ENC_HOST_ENDIAN', 'ENC_BIG_ENDIAN'} allowed`
Thanks for spotting, I corrected it.
Byte 2-4 is left undecoded?

changed this line in [version 5 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/21082/diffs?diff_id=1474372129&start_sha=1976e174da978a2a0ceaf558aef1d6824b71681d#89281250ea041e528a2e7badea571314e81e9218_763_763)
it is always better to display reserved bytes and we can add expert_info if it is not FF

That is a good idea. In the meantime I realized that the definition of this message in J1939-21 is slightly different than in ISO 11783-3: in IsoBus there is an address in the reserved area and also by separate control byte ranges the meaning of the reserved bytes could be transformed to Extended identifier.
